## Neverness to Everness (NTE) Cheats — iOS Mod Menu

**Target Bundle ID:** `com.hottagames.nte`  
**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

### ⚔️ Tab 1 — Combat (`Core Mods`)
- **God Mode** — Block all incoming damage, prevent HP loss & set `bImmuneTotalDeath` on player ASC
- **One-Hit Kill** — Deal instant lethal damage to enemies

### 🏛️ Tab 2 — World & Bank (`Oracle, Gift, Magician & Bank Heist`)
- **Oracle Stone Auto-Open** — Maximizes `AHTOracleStoneActor` pickup/open radius (`99,999`) & auto-triggers refresh
- **Gift & Treasure Auto-Unlock** — Bypasses chest locks & auto-opens `AHTTreasureBoxActor` gift/treasure boxes
- **Auto Collapse Magic Boxes** — Instantly solves & collapses `AHTMagicBoxAnomaly` puzzles
- **5x Multi Magic Spin** — Triggers `5x` rapid spins per Magic Spin start request
- **Auto Claim Bank Awards** — Automatically requests Score, Quest & Manual Bank Heist (`ERobBankMsgCToS`) awards
- **Claim All Bank Awards & Quests (1-Tap)** — Sends `GetAllScoreAward`, `SubmitAllQuest` & `ManualAward` immediately

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves updated offsets across game updates without waiting for a new `.deb`
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

**v1.5.0**
- Initial release for NTE: Neverness to Everness (`com.hottagames.nte` v1.5.0)
- Includes 15 relocation-safe UE5 ARM64 AOB auto-offset signatures + 1-User Device Token Lock
